findings.finding: PR riscv-p-spec#175 adds P-extension saturating subtract instruction definitions (PSSUB.B/H/W, PSSUBU.B/H/W, SSUB, SSUBU, PSSUB.DB/DH/DW, PSSUBU.DB/DH/DW) to the RISC-V ISA specification. OpenSBI contains zero code related to these instructions — no implementation, no emulation, no SBI interface. These are hardware-executed ALU instructions with no M-mode firmware involvement. The security spec's concern (function_loss from incorrect saturating subtract behavior) is a hardware/ISA compliance issue, not applicable to OpenSBI firmware.
